name: GJH Mall Visitor v3
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modelling
creation_method: Blender 5.1.2 headless build: MPFB2 v2.0.18 (MakeHuman) human base and game_engine skeleton, tuned to a young Asian adult male at 1.78 m; hoodie, tee, trousers and sneaker uppers are offset shells of the body surface; hair clumps, backpack, lanyard, badge, watch and soles are procedural.
